interpretation: Resource counts measure coverage, not independent confirmations or popularity. Positions are discovery sequence only. Input metrics are fixed; output results remain unknown until genuine Compiler and edition evidence exists.

daily_policy.admission: Accept only useful, credible, accessible sources with documented role, independence and event relevance; record rejected or deferred candidates and reasons. Never add a weak source solely to increase counts.
daily_policy.change_control: Log actual method/source changes and their reasons. Preserve prior versions. Do not promise monotonic improvement. Separate comparable-source changes from expanded-sample changes.
daily_policy.impact: Record verified input adoption, actual topic-by-format searches, candidate yield, bundle-verified selections, gaps/rejections, source independence, freshness and observed operational cost/time. Selected mapping is association, not causal uplift. Unknown measurements remain null.
daily_policy.publication: No new quota, publication gate, schedule or paid service.
